messages:
ida: quick note — after yesterday's dedupe sweep, newmodel-q4b shows lower embedding recall on retrieval prompts and more repetitive completions in longform. noticed during eval harness run.

sam: what dropped in the harness? numbers?

ida: embed-recall@1 down from 0.84 -> 0.72 on dev-holdout. gen distinct-3 down ~12%. human checks flagged looped clarifiers.

rzl: did dedupe remove a lot of varied anchors or mostly shorts?

ida: mostly long clarifiers and multi-turn anchors. dedupe rule was simhash < 0.915 + short-turn prune. removed ~900 anchors from golden.

sam: different from earlier regressions — this smells like distribution shift (holdout missing long contexts) + quant sensitivity. can we bisect kernels?

rzl: I can run a kernel-bisect: int4-attn-fast vs int8-fp16-mix for attention and see diffs. also want a pre/post dedupe eval on same prompts.

ida: plan: 1) reinstate a micro-slice of 400 removed anchors (prefer long, high-entropy) 2) run pairwise A/B fp16 vs q4b across pre-dedupe holdout 3) kernel bisect if A/B still fails 4) labeler triage for semantic uniqueness.

label-ops-bot: Ticket created: LO-921 restore 400 anchors snapshot -> assigned to labeling-ops, SLA 72h.

rzl: I'll queue the A/B and kernel-bisect. Using eval-harness v2: 
```bash
./run_eval.sh --model q4b-int4 --baseline fp16 --prompts ./holdout/pre_dedupe.json --out /tmp/ab_q4b_fp16.json
```

curie-bot: Eval job queued: run-20260323-889. Expect results in ~45m.

sam: if bisect shows attention kernel is culprit, try fallback to int8-attn for canary and see if embed-recall recovers. also test small temperature increase for generation (0.8->0.95) as mitigation.

ida: agree. rzl pls keep the micro-slice distinct from current golden (sem-sim < 0.86) so it's informative.

rzl: picking anchors now, will push list to /datasets/microgolden/restore-1754321999.json and ping when ready.

ida: thanks. will follow up when eval results arrive. if anyone else sees similar drift on other quant variants drop a note here. :mag:
